purpose: Course adapter of the evaluation executor with two routes. GR00T route: same task, scene, controller, GR00T server and scoring as the evaluation of the course checkpoint, with the documented changes. Onboard route (--course-onboard, entry lab/onboard_scene.py): the installed onboard controller unchanged, with the same course start-up.
changes: standing61 start-up (both routes): HOME joints locked by temporary joint limits on the measured grounded root (grounded-pose.json), free root, zero external wrench
GR00T route: brake released when the first real GR00T prediction has returned and before it is applied
GR00T route: scoring and task clock start at the brake release; nothing is scored while joints are locked; no release if no prediction arrives
GR00T route: Nav2 planner is not started (original GR00T episodes sent no planner query); a stand-in refuses any query
GR00T route: onboard YOLO detector session is not started (it is only queried when no walking policy server is set)
onboard route: installed detector session, Nav2 session, BallReacquisitionNavigator, K10 runtime and velstand actor (checked at start); no GR00T modules loaded

onboard route: HOME held with no network evaluation while locked; brake released after the first velstand output and before it is applied, once the locked robot has settled, has stayed stationary for the last 0.5 s (NoSupportStartup thresholds) and fresh RGB, ToF and BODY50 data are complete and finite; task clock, scoring, navigation and detection start at the release; not released by 10 s fails with joints locked; any nonzero actual external wrench fails
optional Isaac Sim window (--visualizer kit, default for learners)
inference server and trainer run through portable_launch.py, which rebinds the recorded base-model path to the pinned revision on the current machine
not_a_reproduction: The development 2/5 of the course checkpoint used the original start-up; results with this adapter are new experiments. Onboard-route results with this start-up are likewise new experiments, not reproductions of runs with the earlier support fixture.
